slices.objective: Add the offline plumbing the private regression lane needs around the merged comparator (src/rocksmith_cdlc_generator/corpus_differential.py): a command-line harness that reads two caller-supplied JSON note files (a reference and a generated arrangement), a required trust tier A/B/C and a required lane (independent_generation or importer_fidelity), runs compare_arrangements, and writes only the sanitized report to a caller-supplied output path. The two lanes stay separate: an importer_fidelity result is labelled as such and must never be reported as generation accuracy. Tests use synthetic fixtures only. Roadmap: docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md; issue #693 slice 6 (unattended local regression lane), docs/private-rocksmith-library-regression-corpus.md.
acceptance: A console command (registered next to the existing cdlc-* commands) takes --reference, --generated, --trust-tier {A,B,C}, --lane {independent_generation,importer_fidelity} and --out, loads both note files as lists of onset_seconds, duration_seconds, midi and optional string and fret, and refuses malformed input with a clear error

The output file contains only CorpusDifferential.sanitized() plus the lane, the SHA-256 of each input file and the repository build identity; it never contains note data, input paths, titles or any other input content
The command refuses to write its output inside the repository checkout, so private-corpus results cannot be committed by accident
The exit code distinguishes PASS, REVIEW_REQUIRED and FAIL, and an importer_fidelity run is labelled so it cannot be counted as independent generation accuracy

Tests use synthetic note files only, cover both lanes, the sanitization guarantee, the in-repository output refusal, malformed input and the three exit codes; no private song material, PSARC or audio is read or committed
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.

slices.objective: Evidence first, then repair. Run one lawful real-song export through stages 9-12 of docs/import_to_export_chain_audit.md (Rocksmith XML export, DLC Builder handoff, returned PSARC verification) using the private, outside-Git regression corpus allowed by PROJECT_PLAN.md rule 26 (#693: copies only, the live game library stays read-only). Record only sanitized per-stage PASS/FAIL, tool versions and content hashes. If a stage fails reproducibly, repair the smallest failing seam with a regression test that fails before the change and passes after, with provenance. If every stage passes, record that no seam is broken and leave in-game load as owner-run Product Reality; do not invent a defect. Roadmap: docs/OWNER_APPROVED_ROADMAP_2026-10-25.md#next-slices item 2.
acceptance: A sanitized stage-by-stage record (PASS/FAIL, tool versions, content hashes, no song bytes, no paths into the private corpus) for the audited real-song export is committed under docs/
If a stage failed reproducibly: the smallest repair, with a regression test that fails on the pre-change code and passes after, and provenance linking it to the recorded failure
If no stage failed: the record says so, no source change is made, and in-game load is marked PENDING owner-run Product Reality rather than claimed

No commercial audio, PSARC, CFSM export or private score bytes are committed or uploaded; live Rocksmith and NoCableLauncher files are not modified; musical correctness is not weakened to make a stage pass
Canonical preflight, required CI checks and review pass at the exact head; no gate may be weakened.
